```{r setup, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

source("Libraries.R")
merged_data <- read.csv("Input/merged_data.csv")

# metto a posto la tipologia di variabile
cols_date <- c("Data_di_nascita", "Data_esordio", "Data_diagnosi", "Data_prelievo_T0", "data_referto_T6", "data_referto_T12", "data_referto_T18", "data_referto_T24", "data_referto_T30", "data_referto_T36", "data_cambio_terapia", "sample_collection_date", "glc_date_before_t0")
merged_data[cols_date] <- lapply(merged_data[cols_date], as.Date)
cols_factor <- c("lesioni_T6", "relapse_T6", "lesioni_T12", "relapse_T12", "lesioni_T18", "relapse_T18", "lesioni_T24", "relapse_T24", "lesioni_T30", "relapse_T30", "lesioni_T36", "relapse_T36", "cambio_terapia", "lesion_burden", "bone_marrow_lesions", "subtentorial_lesions", "gadolinium_contrast", "full_recovery")
merged_data[cols_factor] <- lapply(merged_data[cols_factor], factor, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
cols_factor2 <- c("naive", "smoking_habit", "antibiotic_use", "spike_in")
merged_data[cols_factor2] <- lapply(merged_data[cols_factor2], factor, levels = c("Yes", "No"))
cols_factor3 <- c("glucocorticoid_treatment", "gc_treatment", "prognosis_at_onset")
merged_data[cols_factor3] <- lapply(merged_data[cols_factor3], factor, levels = c("Positive", "Negative"))
merged_data$physical_activity <- factor(merged_data$physical_activity, levels = c("active", "sedentary", "partially_active"))
merged_data$simplified_batch <- factor(merged_data$simplified_batch, levels = c("1-3", "4-5"))
merged_data$disease_activity <- factor(merged_data$disease_activity, levels = c("higher_activity", "lower_activity"))
merged_data$sex <- factor(merged_data$sex, levels = c("M", "F"))
merged_data$sequencing_batch <- factor(merged_data$sequencing_batch, levels = c("1", "2", "3"))
merged_data$CENTRO <- factor(merged_data$CENTRO, levels = c("CLERICO", "NAPOLI", "MOLINETTE", "CRESM"))
merged_data$clinical_presentation <- factor(merged_data$clinical_presentation)
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("EDSS"),
      ~ ordered(as.numeric(.x), levels = seq(1, 10, by = 0.5))
    )
  )
cols_numeric <- c("MEDAS", "cortisone_T6", "cortisone_T12", "cortisone_T18", "cortisone_T24", "cortisone_T30", "cortisone_T36", "age_at_t0", "bmi", "pyr_mds", "dna_quantification", "days_gc_collection", "percent_th17", "treg_il10_pos", "treg_cd39_pos", "age", "age_at_diagnosis")
merged_data[cols_numeric] <- lapply(merged_data[cols_numeric], as.numeric)

```


```{r setup, include=TRUE}
summary(merged_data)
```

The court is composed by 30 patients affected by multiple sclerosis and is distributed in the following way:
Sex: 9 Man, 20 Female and 1 NA.
Naive: 18 Naive, 11 non Naive, 1 NA.
Age at T0 (baseline): Min 20.00, Max 55.00, Mean age 37.37, Median 38.50.
BMI (Body mass index): Min 16.80, Max 32.10, Mean bmi 23.54, Median 21.80. (9 NA's).
MEDAS (Mediterranean Diet Adherence Screener): Min 35.00, Max 85.70, Mean 50.55, Median 42.90. (8 NA's).
Smoking habit: 7 Yes, 17 No. (6 NA's).
Physical activity: 5 Active, 7 partially active, 9 sedentary. (9 NA's).
Glucocorticoid treatment before T0: 12 Yes, 6 No. (12 NA's).
The disease activity is in prevalence higher activity.

```{r setup, include=TRUE}

#tabella riassuntiva sottoforma di dataset
Summary_table <- bind_rows(
  merged_data %>%
    dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-any_of(c("percent_th17", "treg_cd39_pos", "treg_il10_pos"))) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "val") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Variable) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      All = paste0(round(mean(val, na.rm = TRUE), 2), " ± ", round(sd(val, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
      `N missing` = as.character(sum(is.na(val))),
      .groups = "drop"
    ),
    
  merged_data %>%
    dplyr::select(where(is.factor), where(is.character), where(is.ordered)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-any_of(c("ID", "NOTE", "nuova_terapia", "previous_therapy", "sample_type"))) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), 
                        names_to = "Var_Name", 
                        values_to = "Level", 
                        values_transform = list(Level = as.character)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Var_Name, Level) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      All = paste0(n, " (", round((n / nrow(merged_data)) * 100, 1), "%)")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(`N missing` = as.character(sum(is.na(merged_data[[Var_Name]])))) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Variable = paste0(Var_Name, " [", Level, "]")) %>%
    dplyr::select(Variable, All, `N missing`)
)


print(Summary_table, n=164)


####tabella riassuntiva stile paper

#variabili numeriche
tab_num <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("percent_th17", "treg_cd39_pos", "treg_il10_pos"))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "val") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(variable) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    All = paste0(round(mean(val, na.rm = TRUE), 2), " ± ", round(sd(val, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
    `N missing` = as.character(sum(is.na(val))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#variabili categoriche
vars_cat <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::select(where(~is.factor(.) | is.character(.) | is.ordered(.)), 
                -any_of(c("ID", "NOTE", "nuova_terapia", "previous_therapy", "sample_type"))) %>%
  colnames()
lista_cat <- lapply(vars_cat, function(v) {
  miss_count <- as.character(sum(is.na(merged_data[[v]])))
  
levels_df <- merged_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(level = as.character(!!sym(v))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(level)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      All = paste0(n, " (", round((n / nrow(merged_data)) * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `N missing` = ""
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(variable = paste0("   ", level)) %>%
    dplyr::select(variable, All, `N missing`)
  
  bind_rows(
    tibble(variable = v, All = "", `N missing` = miss_count),
    levels_df
  )
})

tab_cat_final <- bind_rows(lista_cat)

#unione 
table_1_final <- bind_rows(tab_num, tab_cat_final)

# Pulizia finale NA residui (se presenti)
table_1_final[is.na(table_1_final)] <- ""


print(table_1_final, n=168)



```
